name: Faith Of A Child
overview: Scripture reveals that the faith of a child exemplifies humility and trust essential for entering the kingdom of heaven, as Jesus teaches that one must become like little children to be great in God's kingdom (Matthew 18:3-4). Children are not only to be welcomed and protected in their faith (Matthew 19:14; 18:6) but also trained diligently in the ways of the Lord so that their faith endures throughout life (Proverbs 22:6). The psalmist highlights that even from the mouths of babes, God establishes strength against His enemies, underscoring the power and importance of childlike faith (Psalms 8:2).
